Printing & use

Enjoy the pages

You may download and print these designs for personal, family, and classroom coloring, without charge. You may share photographs of your own colored versions.

Share the page, not a new download

When recommending a design online, link to its page here. Please do not sell the files, upload them as your own collection, or redistribute the uncolored downloads on another website.

AI-assisted artwork

The designs and Patrick’s portrait were generated with AI. These guidelines describe the studio’s permitted uses; they do not claim exclusive copyright in every AI-generated element.

Printer settings

Choose the A4 or US Letter version matching your paper. Use portrait orientation and actual size (100%). Your printer and materials determine the final result.
